text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪
Next weekend is my hangout day with Acute-san♪
I can't wait for ogura red bean pancakes~♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, today's lucky direction and
lucky color are... hmm, hmm.
Northeast and lavender, huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"If it's lavender,
I have just the skirt for it.
I'll wear that one♪"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it's been a really long time
since I last wore that skirt...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Just to be sure, maybe? Just in case?
Should I try them on to see if they fit right~?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh... My waist is... mmmngh~~... Aah!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...W-What should I do? I won't be able to wear my lucky color like this... I mean...
Ogura red bean pancakes... so many calories..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I can't let it stay like this, I have to lose weight!
For the sake of my lucky, happy
outting with Acute-san~~~~!!!!"
Driven by her promise to Wonder Acute, Copano Rickey worked furiously hard. She successfully managed to get her weight back to normal.
